reviews.title: Battery drains too fast
reviews.body: The battery drained from 100% to 20% in one evening. Runtime is far shorter than expected for a 300Wh unit.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer A

reviews.title: Fan noise at night
reviews.body: The fan is loud and cycles on every few minutes. I could hear it from the tent.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer B

reviews.title: Solar charging is very slow
reviews.body: Solar input is slow even in full sun. It took all day with a 200W panel.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer C

reviews.title: App loses connection
reviews.body: The app disconnects and the display sometimes shows the wrong percentage.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer D

reviews.title: Still drains quickly
reviews.body: Battery still drains quickly after the firmware update.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer P

reviews.title: AC output shuts down
reviews.body: The AC output shuts down when I plug in a 500W kettle. It cannot handle the load.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer F

reviews.title: Arrived late and box damaged
reviews.body: Delivery took three weeks and the package arrived dented. Customer service did not reply.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer G

reviews.title: Heavy and bulky
reviews.body: Too heavy to carry to a campsite. The handle is uncomfortable.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer H

reviews.title: Confusing instructions
reviews.body: The manual is confusing and the setup guide is incomplete.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer I

reviews.title: Fan is very noisy
reviews.body: The fan is noisy under load and the app disconnects.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer Q

reviews.title: Charging brick gets very hot
reviews.body: The charger gets hot during charging and smells like burning plastic. Safety concern.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer K

reviews.title: Display reading inaccurate
reviews.body: The display shows 100% but the unit shuts down after 10 minutes.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer L

reviews.title: Missing cable in package
reviews.body: Package was missing the AC cable. Support asked me to wait.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer M

reviews.title: Too heavy for hiking
reviews.body: Weight is too much for backpacking. Fine for car camping.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer N

reviews.title: Solar charging is slow
reviews.body: Solar charging is slow and the panel input is not stable.
reviews.author: Public Reviewer R
